title: What If Every Plane on Earth Was Grounded?

scenes.text: What if every plane was grounded tomorrow? The sky would change in a way you could measure.
We have seen a tiny version. After September eleventh, 2001, all US flights stopped for three days.
Contrails normally block some sunlight by day and hold in some heat at night, which evens out temperatures.
With no contrails, the gap between day highs and night lows widened by about one point one degrees Celsius across America.
In the regions with the most contrails, the change was more than twice the national average.
The scientists said at least part of it came from the missing contrails. Ground every flight, and the sky itself would show it.

description:
What if every plane on Earth was grounded?
After 9/11, three days without US flights widened the daily temperature swing by about 1.1 degrees Celsius, a Nature study found.
